architecture.title: Two image fine-tunes on one Spark — a VLM that reads images, a diffusion model that draws them
architecture.caption: Both recipes live in the playbook repo on the Spark and run in Docker. Labs 01 and 03 prepare and validate the datasets on the laptop. Labs 02 and 04 run what the playbook's buttons and scripts run, headless under nohup, and read the logs back. Only one of them should run at a time: both want most of the 128 GB.

sequence.title: Lab 12-2 — GRPO on one image, one step
sequence.caption: GRPO has no answer text to imitate. For each image the model writes num_generations answers, the two reward functions score each one, and the update pushes toward the higher-scoring answers. From src/train_image_vlm.py and train.yaml (rewards 2.0 and 5.0, 2 generations).
